The covenant requires  

\[
\text{DSCR}_t=\frac{\text{NOI}_t}{\text{Debt\;service}_t}\ge 1.25 .
\]

For months 7–12 the debt service is \$140, so we need  

\[
\frac{\text{NOI}_7}{140}\ge 1.25\;\Longrightarrow\; \text{NOI}_7\ge 175 .
\]

With a constant monthly NOI growth rate \(r\),

\[
\text{NOI}_t =130\,(1+r)^{\,t-1}.
\]

At month 7 (\(t=7\)) we have \((1+r)^{6}\) in the exponent:

\[
130\,(1+r)^{6}\ge 175\;\Longrightarrow\; (1+r)^{6}\ge \frac{175}{130}= \frac{35}{26}\approx 1.346153846 .
\]

Hence  

\[
1+r = \left(\frac{35}{26}\right)^{\!1/6}.
\]

Evaluating the sixth root:

\[
\left(\frac{35}{26}\right)^{1/6}=e^{\frac{\ln(35/26)}{6}}
\approx e^{0.04954192}\approx 1.05078964 .
\]

Thus  

\[
r = (1+r)-1 \approx 1.05078964-1 = 0.05078964 .
\]

Rounded to four decimal places, the minimum constant monthly NOI growth rate is  

\[
\boxed{0.0508}.
